method: A clean settlement pays the usual prices and runs the usual waves, bosses, targeting and damage in fixed simulation steps; at most one paid order per game second, with Rain aimed when ready. Two 700/701-game-second checkpoints were restored to compare 16 different continuations. The continuations share their respective seed/early route. Boss observations below are sampled every five game seconds, rather than exact remaining HP on the final Hall-death frame.

fresh_full_campaign.strategy: Earlier investment in both producers, clustered cannons with later arrow support, repairs by rebuilding wall cells, Hall upgrades and Rain. Clean opening, no inherited save or grants.
